preservation: Every original archive entry outside the listed changes is byte-identical.

behavior.accountPlanRule: Groq/Gemini/Cohere keys require explicit per-key Free/trial confirmation, expiring after 30 days. Gemini billing must remain OFF; Cohere must use a trial/evaluation key. Catalog access is never treated as billing verification.
eligibleRoutes: OpenRouter fresh zero-price text with zero-price ceiling
Gemini documented free text models on user-confirmed billing-OFF keys
Cohere text chat on user-confirmed trial keys
blockedRoutes: Direct Mistral API: current documentation requires billing activation
Direct Claude API and Stability inference: no verified permanent free route
Paid/unknown OpenRouter entries and paid model pins
behavior.affinity: Successful provider/key/model is preferred until it fails or the user changes its pin; health checks do not replace model affinity. Utility provider affinity is separate.
behavior.timeoutsNote: Active streams can continue; these are attempt/routing budgets, not guaranteed end-to-end response times. No sleeps for cooldowns.
behavior.nativeCompatibility: Existing Android workers remain zero-price OpenRouter only. Restored direct-provider chat is kept in the WebView instead of handing it to an incompatible worker. Native results feed successful model affinity back to the page.
